analyst.summary: Bajaj Electricals makes consumer appliances (including Morphy Richards and Nirlep brands) and lighting/EPC solutions. The company had a difficult FY26 -- revenue declined and it swung to a full-year loss, driven partly by one-off charges (labour-code provisions, an impairment, and inventory-mould write-downs) but also by genuine, ongoing pressure on margins and volumes in its core appliances business. The lighting segment is growing, but it is not yet big enough to offset the weakness elsewhere.
